aliases: 落日灰壳那种怀旧科技

description.zh: "过去的人想象中的未来"的视觉语言：奶油橙棕的暖色底、粗圆角机身、轨道线 与星球贴纸、像素化屏幕与 CRT 荧光，乐观却已过时的科技感。它把登机舱 仪表盘、老式家电与太空竞赛海报揉成一种温暖的怀旧未来。
description.en: The future as imagined by the past: cream-orange-brown warm palettes, chunky rounded casings, orbit lines and planet decals, pixel screens and CRT phosphor — optimistic tech that has aged. Space-age dashboards, vintage appliances and space-race posters fold into one warm nostalgic future.

use_when.zh: 游戏 音乐 与怀旧科技主题的品牌叙事
use_when.en: Games, music and nostalgia-tech brand storytelling

use_when.zh: 需要温暖乐观的未来感，拒绝冰冷的赛博叙事
use_when.en: Futures that feel warm and optimistic instead of cold-cyber

use_when.zh: 概念产品 活动页，"过去的明天"是故事本身
use_when.en: Concept pages where "yesterday's tomorrow" is the story

avoid_when.zh: 现代工具型产品，旧机身隐喻降低效率感知
avoid_when.en: Modern productivity tools — vintage casing metaphors hurt perceived efficiency

avoid_when.zh: 极简高端品牌，复古装饰稀释品牌信号
avoid_when.en: Minimal premium brands where retro garnish dilutes the signal

avoid_when.zh: 需要无障碍大对比的场景，暖色低对比组合常见
avoid_when.en: Accessibility-critical contexts — warm palettes often run low contrast

note.zh: 五六十年代太空竞赛，轨道线与火箭
note.en: 50s–60s space race — orbit lines and rockets

note.zh: 七八十年代 CRT 与米色机身仪表盘
落日条纹网格地平线，与 Y2K 相邻
note.en: Sunset stripes over grid horizons — adjacent to Y2K

task.zh: 播放电台由用户手势启动 WebAudio 合成单音；可播放/暂停、选择三曲、调节音量。电台、巡演、磁带、REC 有对应内容，明确本地合成并非真实广播或录音上传。
task.en: Play the radio starts a WebAudio synthesized tone after a user gesture. Play/pause, choose among three tracks and adjust volume. Radio, Tour, Tapes and REC reveal content; disclose local synthesis, not live broadcasting or recording uploads.

checks.zh: 逐一操作 SYNTH-84 原导航和主 CTA，检查对应内容与返回路径，不只是点击提示。
checks.en: Use SYNTH-84’s original navigation and primary CTAs; inspect content and return paths, not just click notices.

checks.zh: 完成上述 SYNTH-84 操作后修改输入或撤销，检查结果与状态同步。
checks.en: Complete the SYNTH-84 task, then change inputs or undo and inspect the matching result/state.

checks.zh: 用键盘和 390px / 320px 检查重排、焦点、校验；区分工具栏重载和内部清空，核对刷新后状态复位。
checks.en: Check reflow, focus and validation with keyboard and 390px / 320px viewports; distinguish toolbar reload from in-page clearing and inspect reset-on-reload boundaries.

notes.zh: 色板锁在暖调：奶油 #F2E4C2 杏橙 #E8965A 陶土棕 #8A4B2E 配一点湖蓝 #3D7A99 点缀；机身感来自大圆角（20px+）+ 双重内阴影（上亮下暗）模拟 塑料厚度；轨道线用细椭圆边框，网格地平线用 repeating-linear-gradient； 文字可混用宽体几何无衬线与等宽屏显字。深色模式转为 CRT：暖黑底加荧光 琥珀或青色屏显字。
notes.en: Lock the palette to warm tones: cream #F2E4C2, apricot #E8965A, terracotta #8A4B2E with a dash of lake blue #3D7A99. Casing comes from big radii (20px+) plus a double inset shadow (lit top, dark bottom) faking plastic thickness; orbit lines are thin ellipse borders; grid horizons use repeating-linear-gradient. Mix wide geometric sans with mono screen type. Dark mode goes CRT — warm black with phosphor amber or cyan type.

basic.zh: 用复古未来主义（Retro-Futurism）设计界面：奶油橙棕暖色底、粗圆角机身感 卡片、轨道线与像素屏幕点缀，呈现"过去想象的未来"。
basic.en: "Design an interface in Retro-Futurism style: cream-orange-brown warm ground, chunky rounded casing cards, orbit lines and pixel-screen accents — the future as imagined by the past."

design.zh: 复古未来设计规范：底色奶油 #F2E4C2 到杏橙 #E8965A 渐变；卡片大圆角 24px，上缘亮 内下缘暗的双重内阴影模拟塑料机身；按钮为胶囊形 或方形 大按钮，配湖蓝 #3D7A99 点缀；轨道线用 1px 椭圆，网格地平线用横向 repeating-linear-gradient；标题宽体几何无衬线，数据用等宽屏显字； 深色模式为 CRT 暖黑底 + 荧光琥珀字。
design.en: "Retro-futurism spec: cream #F2E4C2 to apricot #E8965A gradient ground; cards at 24px radii with a double inset shadow (lit top edge, dark bottom) for plastic casing; pill or chunky square buttons with lake blue #3D7A99 accents; 1px ellipse orbit lines and a repeating-linear-gradient grid horizon; wide geometric sans headings, mono screen numerals. Dark mode: CRT warm black with phosphor amber."

implementation.zh:
用当前风格完成 SYNTH-84 同品牌完整页面，从原首屏延续到内容、具体操作结果和返回路径，而非孤立控件或局部 demo。保留品牌、首屏文案、素材、构图、tokens 与全部 variants。以当前 YAML preview 为品牌、原导航与 CTA 的事实来源，不替换成通用营销模板。

当前页面是 SYNTH-84 合成器电台：保留 #140A33→#3D1170→#7A1F63 深紫渐变、#FF71CE 粉色强调、等宽大写 DRIVE INTO / THE SUNSET、右侧柱形图及三张半透明卡。播放器沿用 FM 84.0、本地三曲和粉到橙的均衡器，不引入原子火箭、1968、奶油塑料机身或 CRT 琥珀配色，也不新增透视地平线。只有实际播放时均衡器按现有 .8s 动画，暂停和 reduced-motion 均停止。

复用当前 preview.tokens：背景 linear-gradient(180deg,#140A33 0%,#3D1170 62%,#7A1F63 100%)；前景 #FFE8F6；强调 #FF71CE / #2A0A2E；卡面 rgba(255,113,206,.12)；边框 rgba(255,113,206,.45)；圆角 6px；字体 'SF Mono', Menlo, monospace；卡影 none。

dark 与 variants 复用 generic-style-pages.css 已有工作区选择器，不据通用历史变体重画首屏；保留 renderer 内各视觉面板的局部高光、渐变和投影。

播放电台由用户手势启动 WebAudio 合成单音；可播放/暂停、选择三曲、调节音量。电台、巡演、磁带、REC 有对应内容，明确本地合成并非真实广播或录音上传。

静态封面、详情演示与 /style-scenes/retro-futurism/（英文 /en/style-scenes/retro-futurism/）共用 renderer；静态封面不嵌套真实按钮，详情在独立文档中启用同款页面的语义控件与品牌内容延续。原导航和 CTA 必须到达对应内容或工作流，不用占位链接、仅变颜色或一句 toast 代替结果。

操作状态仅存在当前页面内存；刷新、工具栏重载/重置与模式切换均恢复初始状态，不使用 localStorage 或 sessionStorage。页内清空/重置用于撤销本次操作，不暗示跨页或持久保存。

提供返回、取消或清空/重置路径，说明仅当前页内存的状态边界；不伪装真实支付、邮件、登录、AI 或云同步。桌面、390px、320px 按内容换行重排，保留可读字号和触控目标，不整体缩小桌面页。控件有可访问名称、键盘操作、可见焦点；弹层支持关闭和焦点返回，表单校验与结果可被辅助技术读到；尊重 prefers-reduced-motion。
implementation.en:
Build a complete SYNTH-84 page in this style, extending the original hero into content, concrete operations and return paths rather than isolated controls or a partial demo. Preserve brand, hero copy, assets, composition, tokens and all variants. The current YAML preview is authoritative for the brand, original navigation and CTAs; never substitute a generic marketing template.

The current page is the SYNTH-84 synth radio: retain the #140A33→#3D1170→#7A1F63 purple gradient, #FF71CE pink accent, uppercase monospace DRIVE INTO / THE SUNSET, right-side bar chart and translucent cards. Continue with FM 84.0, three local tracks and the pink-to-orange equalizer, not atomic rockets, 1968, cream plastic casings, CRT amber or a new perspective horizon. Only actual playback runs the existing .8s equalizer animation; pause and reduced motion stop it.

Reuse current preview.tokens: background linear-gradient(180deg,#140A33 0%,#3D1170 62%,#7A1F63 100%); foreground #FFE8F6; accent #FF71CE / #2A0A2E; card rgba(255,113,206,.12); border rgba(255,113,206,.45); radius 6px; font 'SF Mono', Menlo, monospace; card shadow none.

Use generic-style-pages.css’s existing workspace dark/variants selectors rather than redrawing the hero from generic historical variants; retain each rendered visual panel’s local highlights, gradients and shadows.

Play the radio starts a WebAudio synthesized tone after a user gesture. Play/pause, choose among three tracks and adjust volume. Radio, Tour, Tapes and REC reveal content; disclose local synthesis, not live broadcasting or recording uploads.

Share one renderer between static covers, the detail experience and /style-scenes/retro-futurism/ (English /en/style-scenes/retro-futurism/). Static covers contain no nested live buttons; the detail experience enables the same page’s semantic controls and brand continuation in an independent document. Original navigation and CTAs reach actual content or workflows, not placeholder links, color-only changes or one-line toasts.

Interaction state lives only in this page’s memory. Reload, toolbar reset and mode changes restore initial state; do not use localStorage or sessionStorage. In-page clear/reset undoes this visit’s operations without implying cross-page or persistent saves.

Provide return, cancel or clear/reset paths and disclose the page-memory state boundary; never fake real payments, email, login, AI or cloud sync. Reflow desktop, 390px and 320px layouts with readable text and usable targets rather than shrinking the desktop page. Give controls accessible names, keyboard access and visible focus; overlays close and return focus, validation/results are announced; respect prefers-reduced-motion.

color.en: Deep purple gradient to #7A1F63 with pink #FF71CE

motion.zh: 200–300ms 的霓虹渐亮与扫描线位移，尊重 prefers-reduced-motion
motion.en: 200–300ms neon warm-up and scanline drift; honour prefers-reduced-motion

states.zh: hover 增强铬金与粉光晕；focus 用粉色可见亮环；active 压低亮度；disabled 去光降饱和；error 用洋红霓虹
states.en: Hover brightens the chrome and pink glow; focus shows a visible pink ring; active lowers brightness; disabled loses glow and saturation; error uses magenta neon

keywords.zh: 霓虹渐变 · 复古日落

heroSub.zh: 回到 1984 年想象的未来。
heroSub.en: Return to the future imagined in 1984.
